chart.programText:
A = data('apache.requests', rollup='delta').sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='B', enable=False)

E = (A).percentile(pct=99, over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='E')
